title: Present entry points as archetypes with assessable dimensions
requirements:
- State that a country can match more than one entry point and explain sequencing when they co-occur
- Distinguish scaling coverage, deepening capability, governance and sustainability
- Note that the entry point can be assessed per capability, domain or region
- Require disaggregated assessment of effective coverage before classifying a country as scaling
- Identify non-infrastructure dimensions (governance, workforce, legal, fiscal, connectivity, emergency) that modify the pathway
